correctness.rationale: At rank four the adjugate is c vv^T; differentiating det M gives the five kernel equations v_(j-1)^2=v_j v_(j+1) in characteristic 3. Nonzero solutions have all nonzero coordinates, yielding exactly 11 roots of t^11=1. Symmetry M(x)v=M(v)x and a 4x4 minor nonzero at v=(1,..,1) force x proportional to v; diagonal automorphisms transport all roots. Independent symbolic Hessian determinant and local expansion confirmed homogeneous degree 5, tangent quadratic -sum u_i²+sum u_i u_(i+1) and nonzero determinant 5=2 mod3. F(P_t)=5t≠0 and ord_11(3)=5 prove the arithmetic claims. The lower-rank locus remains outside scope.
